'''Kenji Nojima''' (Japanese: '''野島健児''' ''Nojima Kenji'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Nojima was born on March 16, 1976 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. His father {{wp|Akio Nojima|Akio}} and older brother [[Hirofumi Nojima|Hirofumi]] are also voice actors. Nojimi began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} starting with ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'', where he voiced the main protagonist {{jo|Jimmy}}. He has since gained several other roles in the {{pkmn|animated series}} and {{pkmn|movie}}s.
